caption: The drawing shows a cylindrical pottery jar with slightly curved sides and small handles on both sides near the rim. The jar is depicted in outlined black ink on a beige or off-white background. Centered on the front of the jar is a bird, illustrated with blue and black ink; the bird is shown in profile with an outstretched tail and wings, perched on stylized curved decorative motifs, also in blue and black. At the top section of the jar, the words "WEST TROY, NY POTTERY" appear, written in thin black lettering. The entire image is minimal in color, using primarily black and blue inks for detailing on a neutral, light-colored background. At the bottom right corner of the drawing, there is a small signature reading "John Branting."
title: Crock
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
